title: Friends of the family and Piron at the roof garden
summary: Arthur recalls Gaspards and Piron, who led a fine band at the roof garden, later the Pythian Temple.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Yeah. Different type of music all together. Yeah.

But I know a lot of those fellas, but I couldn't recall their names. I was such a young kid and I seen them. I was around them when they were rehearsing with my daddy's band and all. And I've seen them go rehearsing in the halls and I went there with my brothers to hear them rehearsing, but I know the fellas when I seen them, just like I know these fellas' pictures, remember seeing them, playing with me when I was four, but I couldn't remember all those guys' names. But these two fellas, you know, Gaspin, Vic Gaspin, why I know them so well, they were friends of the families. You see, and they used to come home a lot and I could remember those two guys very well because they used to come by us all the time. But the other guys, I've seen them around, but I don't remember their names. But I remember P. Roam well because I grew up. Time enough to remember him.
And he lived up until 1942 about. Yeah.
He used to play on the old roof guard when I was a small kid. He had a fine band on the roof guard.
Went up for the city hall, the Pithian Temple. Yeah, Pithian Temple.

He used to play there. Before they had a top on it, it was called a roof guard. I've heard about that. That was before they had the top. I had just started out old enough to start dancing. And that was when I was around about 16 or 17 years old. Then it was open. It was called a roof guard. They just had a wall on it about, I'd say about three to four feet high. And then later years, they put a top on it. And then they changed the name to the Pithian Temple, I think. Pithian Temple, I think. Something like that.
Pithian Temple. Pithian Temple, yeah. That was after they put the roof. But I danced up there before they had a roof on it. That was around 1920. Around 1920 when they put the roof on that place.
